messages:
Nat (Acme): Hey team — just finished the signup flow and I can see a key in the console, but every call returns 403. Need this unblocked for our dev testing.
Sam (Support): Sorry about that — can you paste the request ID or a curl snippet? Also share the Project ID or Tenant ID you used.
Nat (Acme): curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC123" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Response: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"access_denied","message":"key not authorized for project"}
Tenant: acme-tenant-42, Project: acme-prod
Priya (Onboarding): Thanks — I pulled the provisioning logs for acme-tenant-42. The API key object was created, but the provisioning job shows a binding error: 
```
provisioner-bot: bind_service_account(project=acme-prod) -> FAILED: ProjectNotFound
```
Priya (Onboarding): Looks like the service account claim was created against a project id that doesn't exist in our org view (maybe user selected a display name mismatch). The console shows the key but it's not bound to the active project so runtime denies requests.
Nat (Acme): Huh — the project exists on our side. How can we rebind the key?
Sam (Support): Two options: 1) quick fix — create a new API key scoped explicitly to acme-prod from the console (that will trigger a fresh binding), or 2) we can re-run the provisioning bind job for the existing key. Which do you prefer?
Nat (Acme): We prefer to keep the key since it's already in our CI. Can you re-run the bind?
Priya (Onboarding): I'll attempt a rebind. Running: `provisioner-bot rebind-key --tenant acme-tenant-42 --project acme-prod --key sk_live_ABC123`
provisioner-bot: rebind started (job id: jb_7821)
Tom (SRE): FYI, we just had a small race where project creation events sometimes arrive after the initial claim; job should auto-retry but it looks like this key hit the non-retry path because of a mapping mismatch. I'll watch the job.
provisioner-bot: job jb_7821 -> RETRYING (lookup: project acme-prod resolved -> uid proj-8802)
provisioner-bot: job jb_7821 -> BIND SUCCESS (service-account: sa-provisioner@proj-8802)
Priya (Onboarding): Bind succeeded. Can you retry the curl now, Nat?
Nat (Acme): Retrying... 
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC123" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"id":"gen_01G...","text":"hello"}
Nat (Acme): Working now, thanks!
Sam (Support): Great — root cause: provisioning job hit a transient project mapping race and took the non-retry path. Priya, can we add a guard to ensure keys show an explicit "pending binding" state in console until bind completes? That reduces customer confusion.
Priya (Onboarding): Agree — I'll file an infra backlog item. For this thread: tagging as resolved, and leaving a short postmortem note.
Tom (SRE): Follow-up: I added an alert for bind failures >= 5/min so oncall gets paged before customers hit it. :raised_hands:
Nat (Acme): Appreciate the quick turnaround. One small ask — can we get a webhook when a key is finally bound? Helps our CI detect readiness.
Sam (Support): Noted, will pass to product. Closing thread after we ship the webhook feature request. :thumbsup:
